## Summary
Describe the limitation and why it matters.

## Current behavior
Explain what the tool does today and how it may mislead users.

## Scope
Call out the affected checks, scan paths, or OSes.

## Recommended follow-up
- [ ] Confirm the expected behavior.
- [ ] Add a regression test.
- [ ] Update docs or warning text.
- [ ] Decide whether this becomes a hard error, a warning, or a documented limitation.

## Notes
Document any environment-specific constraints, false positives, or safety concerns.
